answer: Sybil defence rests on one mechanism: bonded identity with work-earned vouching. Each agent posts slashable collateral, co-signed by two unlinked sponsors. A sponsor vouches only in proportion to settlements it has already completed, so an attacker cloning an identity must first do real paid work, then lock collateral for every copy. A caught clone is burned and its sponsors lose quota. Since identity costs roughly what the work costs, mass registration stops paying: the vine of fake accounts collapses at audit, free signup nectar dries up, and no ember of unbacked reputation survives.
